title: Sea And Me | KEY.co
description_expanded: This stunning coastal retreat in Prominence South offers the perfect blend of modern luxury and seaside charm. With an open floor plan designed for gathering, it boasts a gourmet kitchen with a spacious island and breakfast bar, a hand-crafted dining table that seats ten, and a large living area perfect for relaxation. Two king suites, one on each level, offer private ensuite bathrooms, with the upstairs suite featuring a serene private patio complete with a swinging daybed and rockers. Additional bedrooms include a queen ensuite and a bunk room with private porch access, making this home ideal for groups of all sizes. Outdoor spaces shine with a screened-in porch, large porch swings, and a deck for al fresco dining and grilling, all designed to embrace the coastal lifestyle. Nestled in the heart of Prominence South along Florida’s iconic 30A, this community offers access to resort-style pools, a fitness center, and over 17 miles of bike paths. Guests can enjoy vibrant dining, shopping, and entertainment at The Big Chill, or explore nearby beaches like Deer Lake State Park, Walton Dunes, and Santa Clara, each offering unique charm and easy accessibility. Whether relaxing by the pool, biking scenic paths, or enjoying the soft sands of the Emerald Coast, this home provides an idyllic base for your 30A adventure. With thoughtful amenities including bikes, a propane grill, and a screened porch swing, every detail has been curated for an unforgettable stay.
